findings.fix: Either add `dev-security-auditor` to Tasks 6, 7 and 8 to match the catalog mapping, or state explicitly in the Decisions section why the security reviewer is dropped for TUI navigation, describe text and golden-replay tasks.

findings.fix: Correct Task 5's description to the real scope (register the archiver view in `New()` and `Configure()`, update `TestNew`, `TestView_VersionOK` and `Test_filterViews` counts, add a `TestNew_ArchiverView` guard in the style of `TestNew_StatIOView`). findings.issue: Task 9 says it adds "the 0.12.0 release-notes entries" but its only file to modify is `docs/roadmap-0.12.0.md` — a planning document that has no release-notes section and is archived when the release ships. Update Decision 13 to name the same target so the decision and the task agree.

summary: Template compliance is solid: frontmatter is correct (created 2026-08-05, status draft, branch feature/017-feat-wal-archiver, size M), every required section is present with real content, 10 tasks (limit 15), Final Wave carries the mandatory Pre-deploy QA task, no time-based estimates, no acceptance criteria or TDD anchors inside tasks, no line-number references in task descriptions, and all skills and reviewers are valid catalog names. Wave conflict check is clean — no two tasks in the same wave modify the same file, and both named hotspots (internal/view/view_test.go, report/describe.go) have a single explicit owner. Zero critical findings, so status is approved. Four major items to fix before decomposition: the Per-task verification table numbers do not match the task numbers, Tasks 6-8 drop dev-security-auditor from the code-writing default reviewer set, Task 5 claims a TestViews_Configure scope that does not exist in the test file, and Task 9's release-notes target is a planning document rather than user-facing documentation.
